sentence: This project studies how road transportation can switch to clean energy and designs tools that help communities and policymakers with that change.
This project tests whether the shapes of river bends can be sorted into an alphabet, using computing methods like those used in DNA sequencing.
This project uses how a young child sees the world while moving through a house to teach computer programs to recognize objects and surfaces.
This project builds a computer model that predicts how a heart pump works together with the beating heart of a patient with heart failure.
This project studies how tiny ceramic particles slowly rearrange during manufacturing and how that affects the quality of solid-state battery components.
This project studies why Y chromosomes gain and keep genes from other parts of the genome, using eight closely related species of rodents.
This project builds an open framework that organizes materials data and knowledge so that computers can reason about it to help find and design materials.
This project studies the superconducting properties of high-entropy alloys under high pressure and how their structure can be tuned.
This project builds methods that let robots prove their actions are safe, using game theory, even when very unlikely events happen.
This project uses data science, 3D imaging and surveying methods to assess coral reefs and the species living on them.
This project studies how owls fly quietly while hunting and how their wing feathers reduce sound.
This project holds a conference on how machine learning can help explain the genetic basis of complex traits in plants, animals, and humans.
This project builds language models that use a child's growth and development to give clearer health recommendations to healthcare providers and families.
This project builds deep-learning frameworks that adapt to changing conditions such as available energy and computing power for real-time uses like autonomous vehicles.
This project builds methods to describe, check and compile network protocols that mix quantum and classical parts.
This project builds software powered by embodied artificial intelligence that explains and shows what happens during hands-on experiments in physical labs.
This project holds a conference about exoplanet atmospheres, covering rocky and giant planets and the techniques used to study them.
This project builds an extended reality environment with touch technology and tests whether it helps people understand electromagnetism.
